summary: The registrant BlackRock TCP Capital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a subsidiary's completion of a $535.78 million CLO securitization of middle-market loans. The transaction involved issuance of senior secured notes across five tranches (Class A-1, A-2, B, C, D) bearing interest at SOFR plus 1.55% to 4.75%, plus LLC Interests. Scotia Capital acted as placement agent. This structured financing is a routine capital-markets activity (CLO issuance), not a special situation; it involves no change of control, M&A, or strategic event. There are no change-in-control, premium, or shareholder vote terms to watch.
